verdict.rationale: Dagster's schedules support cron expressions and intervals from hourly to weekly, sensors and declarative automation provide event-driven/sub-hour and condition-based triggers, and manual triggers via the UI/CLI are implicit standard functionality across job/asset runs. Combined with per-asset AutomationCondition.on_cron and sensor-based near-real-time triggers, teams get full control over sync cadence per pipeline. Missing for 10: explicit first-party mention of manual/ad-hoc triggering UI mechanics and independent hands-on confirmation of sub-hour scheduling reliability.
